**Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan**

*Note: I've departed from the reference page's devices (week sidebar, hand-drawn arrow, green/coral, monospace quote) since they belong to a different product. Its hero headline is also far too long for scanning, so Tidepool's stays under 12 words.*

**Visual system:** Slate-teal (#1F4E5A) primary, sand neutrals (#F6F1E7), and a marigold accent (#E8A33D) reserved for CTAs. Headlines in a humanist sans (e.g., Source Sans 3, 56px desktop), body at 18px. Pull quotes in a serif (Source Serif 4) for warmth.

**Sections, top to bottom:**

1. **Nav:** Wordmark left, three links, a marigold "Start free" button right. Sticky, minimal.

2. **Hero:** Split layout, text 45% left, product image 55% right. Headline: "Plan your week together." Subhead: one sentence naming the team use case. Primary CTA plus "See a sample week" secondary link. Imagery: a live-looking Monday–Friday board with three teammates' colored lanes and draggable task cards.

3. **Trust strip:** Single row of team-type labels ("agencies, clinics, studios, co-ops") with a verified customer count. No invented logos.

4. **Problem:** Centered headline "Week plans die in five different chats." Three-column cards, each showing a scattered source (texts, email, sticky notes) with a crossed-out icon.

5. **How it works:** Three numbered steps in a horizontal row: Invite your team, Drop in tasks, Lock the week on Monday. Each step gets a small cropped screenshot.

6. **Feature deep-dive:** Two alternating split rows. First: unfinished tasks roll over automatically. Second: a capacity bar per person. Copy is outcome-led, with one concrete number per row.

7. **Testimonial:** Full-width sand band, large serif quote, attributed with name, role, and team size. Small circular portrait, not stock.

8. **Pricing:** Two cards. Free for teams up to five; flat team plan beside it. Marigold on the recommended tier only.

9. **FAQ:** Five accordion items covering setup time, data export, guest access, and billing.

10. **Final CTA:** Full-bleed teal band, one headline, one button, and a "no card required" line.

11. **Footer:** Link columns, privacy and status links, small wordmark.

**Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan**

*Changes from v1: sharper headline, a clearer problem-to-proof arc, a live sample-week demo in place of a static image, mobile behavior specified, and contrast fixes. The reference page's devices (week sidebar, hand-drawn arrow, green/coral, monospace quote) are not used, since they belong to a different product.*

**Visual system:** Slate-teal (#1F4E5A) for headlines and footer, sand (#F6F1E7) base, marigold (#E8A33D) for primary CTAs only, with slate text on marigold (white on marigold fails contrast). Headlines in Source Sans 3 Semibold (56px desktop, 36px mobile). Body 18px, line height 1.6. Pull quotes in Source Serif 4 Italic. Imagery is real product UI in flat, rounded frames, with no stock photography.

**Sections, top to bottom:**

1. **Nav:** Wordmark left, three links, marigold "Start free" button right. Collapses to a menu icon below 768px.

2. **Hero:** Headline: "Your team's week, planned before Monday starts." Subhead names the use case: "Tidepool gives agencies, clinics, and studios one shared plan that everyone can see and change." Primary CTA plus "Try a sample week" secondary link. Right side shows an interactive mini-board, so visitors can drag a card before signing up.

3. **Proof strip:** One row of team types with a specific, sourced figure (for example, "Teams plan in under 15 minutes per week," cited from your own data). Placeholder until real numbers exist; do not invent logos.

4. **Problem:** Headline: "Week plans die in five different chats." Three cards (texts, email, sticky notes), each with one sentence on the cost, such as a missed deadline or a double-booked room.

5. **How it works:** Three numbered steps: Invite, Drop in tasks, Lock Monday. Each step has a cropped UI frame. On mobile, steps stack vertically.

6. **Feature rows:** Two alternating splits. (a) Unfinished tasks roll to tomorrow automatically. (b) A capacity bar per person shows overload before it happens. Each row leads with an outcome and one concrete number.

7. **Testimonial:** Sand band, large serif quote, with name, role, team size, and a real photo with permission (not stock).

8. **Pricing:** Two cards. Free for up to five people; Team plan for larger groups. Marigold "Recommended" badge on Team only. Prices pulled from a single source of truth.

9. **FAQ:** Five accordion items: setup time, data export, guest access, billing changes, and cancellation.

10. **Final CTA:** Full-bleed teal band, one headline ("Plan next Monday today"), one marigold button, and "No card required."

11. **Footer:** Link columns, privacy, status page, and wordmark. Sits on teal with sand text (passes AA).

**Quality checks:** Every CTA uses the same label, "Start free." Every section has at most one primary action. All text meets WCAG AA contrast. The sample-week demo must work without JavaScript as a static fallback.
